objective: Independently review the exact locally committed Cycle Eight executable worker runtime changes in IRIS Core and the Founder Command Center without modifying either repository.
completion_exclusions: Credentials, spending, deployment, and provider resources
permitted_actions: Inspect the exact Git commits and their diffs
Run repository-pinned formatting, lint, typecheck, test, build, audit, and diagnostic commands that require no installation
Write the review response outside the reviewed repositories
prohibited_actions: Stage, commit, push, create or merge pull requests
Deploy, publish, spend, or create provider resources

acceptance_commands.command: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

required_evidence: Line-supported findings or an explicit no-findings statement
Confirmation that no repository or Git state changed
